name: Prompt field with edge glow
for: The hero prompt box of an AI or developer product: one light runs slowly around its border and blooms outward, so the one input on the page is found first.
how: edge-glow mounted on the box with an inset: it draws the card and its border, and the glow spreads into the margin around it. One lap takes about 12 s.
rules: One lit border per screen; other boxes stay static.
A lap takes 6 to 18 s, never faster.
The text area and buttons sit on the opaque card fill.
a11y: A real form with a labelled textarea and labelled buttons; the canvas is aria-hidden. Reduced motion shows the border still, with its faint idle light.
